name: What materials are available for front doors and which is best?

mainEntity.name: What materials are available for front doors and which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common front door materials include steel, fiberglass, and wood. Steel doors are durable, secure, and energy-efficient, often the most budget-friendly. Fiberglass doors offer excellent durability, energy efficiency, and can mimic the look of wood without the maintenance. Wood doors provide a classic, high-end aesthetic but require more maintenance and are generally less energy-efficient than steel or fiberglass. The 'best' material depends on your priorities for budget, aesthetics, security, and maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options include steel (durable, secure, budget-friendly), fiberglass (durable, energy-efficient, low maintenance), and wood (classic look, high maintenance). The best choice depends on your needs.
